duplicate-node-id.json.why: second node repeats the first node's id (invariant 1)

edge-endpoint-unresolved.json.why: edge points at a node id that does not exist (invariant 2)

parent-unresolved.json.why: node's parent id does not exist (invariant 3)

schema-ref-unresolved.json.why: edge schema_id names a schema that is not in the graph (invariant 4)

ref-schema-id-unresolved.json.why: field ref_schema_id names a schema that is not in the graph (invariant 4)

illegal-node-kind.json.why: node kind 'widget' is not in the enum (invariant 5)

fork-without-source.json.why: edge in an exclusive_group with source null (invariant 9)

tombstone-with-source.json.why: tombstone node that still carries a source (invariant 10)

missing-key.json.why: broken_reason key omitted instead of null (invariant 12, §2.5)

branch-ordinal-without-group.json.why: branch_ordinal set on an edge with no exclusive_group (invariant 14)

duplicate-branch-ordinal.json.why: two alternatives in one exclusive_group share branch_ordinal 0 (invariant 15)

skips-tiers-into-external.json.why: external_call edge with non-empty skips_tiers; external is not a depth (invariant 16)

wrong-schema-version.json.why: schema_version 2 against a version 1 model; must fail loudly (handoff §5.2)

canonical-with-volatile.json.why: parsed_at present in a graph validated as canonical shape (graph model §7.3)

unknown-key.json.why: node carries a key the model does not define

not-an-object.json.why: a JSON array, not a graph object
